annotations.title: CSV to JSON with type inference

description: Convert CSV to JSON rows with per-column type inference (integer, number, boolean, null, string), delimiter auto-detection and a generated JSON Schema. Leading-zero codes (ZIP, CLABE) stay strings. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/csv-to-json.

csv.description: CSV text (UTF-8). Max 1 MiB, 20,000 rows, 512 columns.

csv_base64.description: Alternative to 'csv': base64 bytes (UTF-8 or Latin-1).

null_values.description: Strings treated as null (empty is always null).

name: csv_to_json
